title: While My Guitar Gently Weeps
feel: Steady quarter-note pulse, about 116 bpm (estimate); bridge in A major

alt_voicings.label: Option
alt_voicings.note: keeps A in the bass instead of F♯ (one tab's choice)

why: A **chromatic descending bass under a held chord** (A–G–F♯–F): the core slash-chord idea, and a bridge in the parallel major.
hard_change: **Am/F♯ (thumb on F♯) → Fmaj7**. The Am fingers stay; the thumb lets go and the ring finger takes F on the 4th string.
theory: i–VII–IV (major, Dorian colour)–V in A minor. The bridge shifts to A major: I–iii–vi–iii–ii–V.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: the bass line A–G–F♯–F with the Am shape held.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 80 bpm), on-beat strums.
With the record (form: intro, verse, bridge, verse, solo verse, bridge, verse, fading outro).
